cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You like the blue campaign poster? I'll tell the volunteers they're happy with me in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The colour, yes. Could we work on the slogan together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Of course. I'm glad everyone's accepted my collaborative leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. My first act as campaign leader is to delegate the decision.

mechanism: A copies an apparently affirmative group cue without understanding it and treats the actual limited agreement as appointment to leadership.
confusable: D52 seeks endorsement; D71 treats partial agreement as already confirming leadership.
comparison: Committee date versus collective campaign slogan choice.
seedUse: Keep B budget opposition and volunteer choice as contributions A absorbs into claimed leadership.
